title: Lava Chicken to Rick Astley
description: This project changes the "Lava Chicken" music disc to play a Rick Roll!
body:
THE PACK COULD ALSO WORK ON 1.21.11 - 26.1.2 BUT I NEVER TESTED IT SO R.I.P. XDD

This Resource Pack changes the "Lava Chicken" music disc to play "Never gonna give you up" / to play a "Rick Roll". The song was created by Rick Astley, and somehow thanks to the internet, he turned into an absolute legendary meme! 

This is also a perfect troll pack, since you can just install it on your Friend's PC and then casually play the Lava Chicken music disc.
